scripts.typecheck: for d in */tsconfig.json; do (cd $(dirname $d) && tsc -p . ) || exit 1; done
scripts.validate: for d in */.claude-plugin/plugin.json; do claude plugin validate $(dirname $(dirname $d)) || exit 1; done
scripts.test:plugins: for d in */.claude-plugin/plugin.json; do claude plugin test $(dirname $(dirname $d)) || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run footprint && npm run test:plugins
